notes: DRAFT by Claude for organizers to edit. Recipes are element-symbol -> quantity. 'catalyst' is null or a catalyst id. Points are suggestions; game-balancer agent will tune. 'nick' is each element's street name: it is printed on the bottle and is the ONLY way riddles refer to that element (see design/direction.md, Riddle voice). 'emoji' is kept for legacy/seed use only; the UI draws pixel icons instead.

catalysts.name: Heat
catalysts.flavor: You bring the fire. Half this lab is waiting on you.

catalysts.name: Enzyme
catalysts.flavor: You're the living shortcut. Yeast respects you.

compounds.name: Water
compounds.riddle: You drink me, swim in me, and you're about 60% me. Two tinies, one breath.

compounds.name: Carbon Dioxide
compounds.riddle: I'm the fizz in your soda and the sigh you just let out. One pencil, two breaths.

compounds.name: Carbon Monoxide
compounds.riddle: Silent, invisible, and the reason your ceiling has an alarm. I'm my fizzy sibling with one breath missing.

compounds.name: Methane
compounds.riddle: Cows burp me, kitchens burn me. One pencil with four tinies huddled round it.

compounds.name: Table Salt
compounds.riddle: Salt's metal explodes in water. The green gas is poison. Put them together and you sprinkle the result on fries.

compounds.name: Hydrochloric Acid
compounds.riddle: Your stomach is full of me right now. One tiny, one green gas. Don't lick the bench.

compounds.name: Sodium Hydroxide
compounds.riddle: Soap-makers and drain-unblockers love me. One each of salt's metal, the breath and a tiny.

compounds.name: Quicklime
compounds.riddle: The bone-builder takes one breath and turns into old-school builders' mortar.

compounds.name: Chalk / Limestone
compounds.riddle: Your teacher wrote with me and cliffs are made of me. Bone-builder, pencil, three breaths.

compounds.name: Hydrogen Sulfide
compounds.riddle: I smell exactly like rotten eggs. I'm water's evil twin: keep the two tinies, swap the breath for the yellow one.

compounds.name: Sulfur Dioxide
compounds.riddle: Volcanoes burp me and acid rain starts with me. The yellow one, holding two breaths.

compounds.name: Nitrogen Dioxide
compounds.riddle: The brown haze hanging over a traffic jam. One air, two breaths.

compounds.name: Laughing Gas
compounds.riddle: Dentists use me and you giggle. Two airs, one breath.

compounds.name: Baking Soda
compounds.riddle: Science-fair volcanoes and fluffy cakes need me. Four different ingredients, and the breath shows up three times.

compounds.name: Calcium Chloride
compounds.riddle: Thrown on icy roads and packed into wardrobe damp-catchers. One bone-builder, two green gases.

compounds.name: Ammonia
compounds.riddle: I feed half the world as fertilizer and I smell like cleaning day. One air, three tinies, and they won't hold hands unless somebody squeezes.

compounds.name: Hydrogen Peroxide
compounds.riddle: Water with one breath too many. I bleach hair and fizz on cuts. Forcing in that extra breath takes a jolt.

compounds.name: Ozone
compounds.riddle: I'm the sky's sunscreen. Breath, breath, breath, and only sunlight can stitch the three together.

compounds.name: Glucose
compounds.riddle: Every leaf on campus is cooking me right now. Six, twelve, six, plus the leaves' secret ingredient.

compounds.name: Table Sugar
compounds.riddle: Your chai needs two spoons of me. Twelve pencils, twenty-two tinies, eleven breaths, grown by sugarcane in full sun.

compounds.name: Ethanol
compounds.riddle: Yeast makes me out of sugar, and hand sanitizer is mostly me. Two pencils, six tinies, one breath, and something alive has to help.

compounds.name: Vinegar (Acetic Acid)
compounds.riddle: I'm the sour in salt-and-vinegar chips. Bacteria turn old wine into me. Two, four, two.

compounds.name: Sulfuric Acid
compounds.riddle: Car batteries are full of me and I eat holes in jeans. Two tinies, one yellow, four breaths, forged in fire.

compounds.name: Nitric Acid
compounds.riddle: Rocket fuel and fertilizer both start with me. One tiny, one air, three breaths, cooked into being.

compounds.name: Ethylene
compounds.riddle: I ripen bananas, and every plastic bag starts life as me. Two and four, but only with the fire turned up.

compounds.name: Bleach
compounds.riddle: Table salt plus one breath, but only if you zap salty water first. Your white shirts owe me.

compounds.name: Urea
compounds.riddle: Yes, I'm in pee. I was also the first 'living' chemical ever made in a lab. Ammonia's ingredients plus a pencil and a breath, squeezed hard.
compounds.lockedHint: C ×1 · H ×4 · N ×2 · O ×1 · catalyst: PRESSURE

compounds.name: Caffeine
compounds.riddle: Exam week runs on me. Coffee plants build me: eight, ten, four, two.
compounds.lockedHint: C ×8 · H ×10 · N ×4 · O ×2 · catalyst: ENZYME

compounds.name: Aspirin
compounds.riddle: Headache? Willow bark had my great-grandparent. Nine, eight, four, and a sour shove.

compounds.name: Banana Flavour (Isoamyl Acetate)
compounds.riddle: Fake banana candy tastes like me. Real bananas, less so. Seven, fourteen, two, and an acid has to set us up.

compounds.name: Potassium Chloride
compounds.riddle: Low-sodium salt is secretly me. The banana metal meets the green gas.

compounds.name: Saltpeter
compounds.riddle: The bang in a firework. Banana metal, one air, three breaths.

compounds.name: Rust
compounds.riddle: Every abandoned bicycle on campus is wearing me. Two blood metals, three breaths.

compounds.name: Copper Sulfate
compounds.riddle: Brilliant blue crystals from your school lab. The penny metal, the yellow one, four breaths.

compounds.name: Sand / Quartz
compounds.riddle: Dubai has a LOT of me. The chip-maker, holding two breaths.

compounds.name: Phosphoric Acid
compounds.riddle: The tang in cola. Three tinies, one matchstick, four breaths.

compounds.name: Sodium Fluoride
compounds.riddle: Your toothpaste's secret weapon. Salt's metal, but swap the green gas for the angriest one.

compounds.name: Epsom Salt
compounds.riddle: Sore muscles soak in me. The flash metal, the yellow one, four breaths.

compounds.name: Magnesium Oxide
compounds.riddle: Light me and I burn blinding white, then leave white ash. Flash metal, one breath, fire.

compounds.name: Alumina (Sapphire)
compounds.riddle: Add a pinch of impurity and I'm a sapphire. Two soda-can metals, three breaths, one furnace.

compounds.name: Fool's Gold (Pyrite)
compounds.riddle: I look like treasure. I'm not. One blood metal, two yellows, cooked deep underground.

compounds.name: Bone Mineral
compounds.riddle: You're holding your phone with me. Three bone-builders, two matchsticks, eight breaths, and your body's own machinery.

compounds.name: Teflon (monomer)
compounds.riddle: Nothing sticks to me, not even eggs. Two pencils, four angriest ones, squeezed hard.

compounds.name: Lithium Carbonate
compounds.riddle: Every phone battery starts life as me. Two lightest metals, a pencil, three breaths.

compounds.name: Zinc Oxide
compounds.riddle: The white stuff on a lifeguard's nose. The armour metal, one breath.

compounds.name: Silver Nitrate
compounds.riddle: Election ink that won't wash off your finger. The mirror metal, one air, three breaths.

compounds.name: Potassium Iodide
compounds.riddle: The pills you take in a radiation emergency. The banana metal meets the purple one.

compounds.name: Silver Chloride
compounds.riddle: Old film photos were made of me: I darken when the world looks at me. Mirror metal, green gas, and a flash.

compounds.name: Silver Iodide
compounds.riddle: The UAE fires me into clouds to make it rain. Mirror metal and the purple one, packed tight.

compounds.name: Gold Chloride
compounds.riddle: The treasure refuses to dissolve in anything except one ridiculous acid cocktail. One treasure, three green gases, the strongest sour.

compounds.name: Lithium Iron Phosphate
compounds.riddle: Electric cars run on me. Lightest metal, blood metal, matchstick, four breaths, then charge it up.
compounds.lockedHint: Li ×1 · Fe ×1 · P ×1 · O ×4 · catalyst: ELECTRICITY

compounds.name: Zinc Chloride
compounds.riddle: I live inside the cheap batteries in your TV remote. Armour metal, two green gases, a spark.

compounds.name: Heavy Water
compounds.riddle: I look exactly like water, but an ice cube of me sinks. Two heavy tinies, one breath, pulled apart by a current.

compounds.name: Radiocarbon CO₂
compounds.riddle: Archaeologists date mummies by me. The ticking pencil, holding two breaths.

compounds.name: Heavy-Oxygen Water
compounds.riddle: Hospitals use me to light up body scans. Two ordinary tinies, one heavy breath.

compounds.name: Uranium Hexafluoride
compounds.riddle: The most dangerous thing in this game. One heavyweight, six angriest ones, white-hot.

compounds.name: Chlorophyll a
compounds.riddle: Every green thing on Earth wears me. A huge ring with a flash-metal heart: fifty-five, seventy-two, one, four, five. Sunlight only.
compounds.lockedHint: C ×55 · H ×72 · Mg ×1 · N ×4 · O ×5 · catalyst: LIGHT

compounds.name: Heme
compounds.riddle: I'm why your blood is red. Chlorophyll's cousin, but my heart is the blood metal. Thirty-four, thirty-two, one, four, four.
compounds.lockedHint: C ×34 · H ×32 · Fe ×1 · N ×4 · O ×4 · catalyst: ENZYME
